name: Shakti OBE: hippocampal signal, right hemisphere
origin: Todd Murphy, 8 Coil Shakti OBE recipe
summary: An OBE session after Murphy's recipe for the 8 Coil Shakti: the hippocampal signal over the right hemisphere, in front of and below the right ear and over the right angular gyrus, then sleep about an hour later. The 30 min are this project's choice. Murphy reports that most OBEs came during that later sleep; of the hippocampal signals over the angular gyrus he writes only that 'there's a chance' they may help.
setting: Lie down in a dark, quiet room. Murphy reports that most OBEs came when users fell asleep about 1 h (or 90 min) after a session, so plan to go to sleep then and use your OBE exercises; he expects it to work more often in 'right-hemispheric' people.
schedule: Vendor rules: at most once a week or every 72 h, never on consecutive days; a series of up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. No more than two series over the right angular gyrus; after that, choose another session design.
notes: The vendor suggests 'sessions over the right hemisphere (temporal lobes, parietal lobes or the area behind the parietal lobes)' and names the hippocampal signals as one of three choices (shakti_obe.htm). For the angular gyrus it offers only a guess: 'there's a chance that either of the hippocampal signals may also facilitate out of body experiences when applied over the angular gyrus' (rangularg.htm). No OBE page gives a length. This program plays 30 min on six coils together: FT10 and T10 in front of and below the right ear, TP8, CP6, P6 and P8 around the right angular gyrus; two channels stay silent. The length, the six coils and the sites are this project's choices. The two spots come from a two-coil placement the vendor gives for the modulated 40 Hz signal only (obe45_consent.htm). The vendor has two hippocampal signals and does not say which it means; the standard one is used. The stand-in is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 4 s of silence. It is rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's file is not published. Field strength: the vendor gives 10 to 20 mG without saying where it is measured (mono_proposal.htm, 'Formal Discussion'). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Blanke et al. 2002 evoked an OBE at the right angular gyrus with implanted electrodes; weak-field effects there are untested. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Headache or pressure with hippocampal signals (vendor: about 2%): lower the intensity by one third. Word-finding trouble means stop using the signal. Right-side-only sessions can bring fear. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop at once on fear or any distress.
